products.label: The nine named Pleiades stars, Hipparcos new reduction, CDS I/311
products.process: Preserve Hipparcos sky coordinates, Hp and B-V; derive radial distances that place each star at adopted normal depth 136.7 pc, then reuse the existing prepared catalogue style and write its positions in local parsecs. Generator .local/pleiades-star-placement.mts; no individual star depth is measured.
limitations: Adopted Pleiades model geometry: normal depth 136.7 pc, 0.7 pc beyond the dust model's normal-depth reference of 136.0 pc along ICRS RA 56.67978318 deg, Dec 24.10845447 deg. Individual bright-star depths and their common plane are assumptions; measured sky positions, observed photometry and published parallax/facts remain separate.
Published stellar measurement records retain their reference distances and parallaxes separately from the adopted bright-star plane.
